site.titre: e-mine · Mines and geology of Guinea
site.description: Demonstration platform of the Ministry of Mines and Geology: online requests and document verification (fictitious data).

accueil.presentation: Request one of the Ministry's 15 documents, pay online, track your file and check a document's authenticity with its QR code.
accueil.avertissement: Demonstration platform: all data is fictitious.

catalogue.presentation: The 15 documents issued by the Ministry, with processing time, required documents, signatory and fees. Amounts in Guinean francs (demonstration data).

indisponible.conseil: Please try again in a few minutes.

verification.confidentialite: This page shows no personal data: only what tells you whether the document is authentic. Demonstration platform, fictitious data.

saisie.presentation: Scan the document's QR code with your phone, or enter below the verification code printed under the QR code.
saisie.libelle: Verification code or address read from the QR code
saisie.aide: 32 characters (digits and letters a to f). You can also paste the full address.
saisie.erreur: This is not a valid verification code: check what you typed.

authentique.texte: This document was issued by the e-mine platform and has not been revoked.

nonValide.texte: This document has been revoked by the administration: it must no longer be accepted.

inconnu.texte: Check the code, or scan the QR code again. A document missing from the register must not be accepted.

indisponible.texte: The service is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.

fichier.titre: Compare the file you are shown
fichier.explication: Choose the PDF file: its fingerprint is computed on your device, the file is not sent. The slightest change alters the fingerprint.
fichier.champ: PDF file to compare with the issued document

identique.titre: The file is identical to the issued document
identique.texte: “{nom}” has not been changed since it was issued.

different.titre: The file does not match the issued document
different.texte: “{nom}” has been changed, or it is not the right document. Do not accept it.

illisible.titre: The file could not be read
